name: Isolation boundary
definition: Deployment location, workload packaging, isolation mechanism, orchestration and measurement constraints are separate design axes.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources.

name: Trial lifecycle
definition: A trial connects one agent attempt with environment preparation, execution, artifacts, verification, cleanup and result validity.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources.

name: Evaluation protocol
definition: A result is conditional on model version, scaffold, tools, decoding, budget, task release and grader version, not model name alone.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources.

name: Reward validity
definition: A recorded reward and whether the trial is valid for aggregation are separate decisions; retry and grading policies influence the denominator.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources.

name: State-based grading
definition: An interactive task can be graded from final application or database state rather than a fixed action sequence, without proving all intermediate behavior was acceptable.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources.

name: Pass at k
definition: HumanEval estimates at-least-one success among k attempts with a finite-sample combinatorial estimator; this differs from all-k-success reliability.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources.

name: Scorer contract
definition: Answer extraction, normalization, accepted formats, invalid outputs and aggregation are part of the evaluation protocol and require positive and negative controls.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources.

name: Resource policy
definition: A resource request/reservation and an enforced ceiling are different conditions; CPU throttling, memory OOM and timeout policies can change the evaluated task.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources.

name: Reset state contract
definition: A restorable VM snapshot includes memory, virtual-hardware state and externally managed disk/backing resources; reset must separately account for external services, identities, clocks and connections.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources.

name: Telemetry completeness
definition: Schema-valid logs, complete event capture, resumable state and exactly-once external effects are distinct properties; unknown usage is not zero.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources. Runtime bundle ID concept:trajectory-completeness maps to this existing concept; original bundle retains its local ID.

name: Paired uncertainty
definition: Uncertainty in a difference depends on paired error overlap and the independent sampling unit, not only the two marginal average scores.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources.

name: Judge meta-evaluation
definition: Judge validation should specify the target construct, sample, ties, position, calibration and reference policy; historical agreement percentages are not universal accuracy claims.
notes: Definition is a research synthesis with stated supporting sources.

name: Agent harness
definition: Orchestrates agent, task environment, trial lifecycle, evidence capture and scoring.
notes: Definition imported from stable runtime evidence bundle; source-derived working definition, not an exhaustive taxonomy.

name: Artifact grading boundary
definition: Defines which outputs cross from the agent environment to a verifier.
notes: Definition imported from stable runtime evidence bundle; source-derived working definition, not an exhaustive taxonomy.

name: Agent bridge
definition: Adapts agent model/tool traffic into an evaluation runtime; may change effective generation or capability policy.
notes: Definition imported from stable runtime evidence bundle; source-derived working definition, not an exhaustive taxonomy.

name: Runtime budget unit
definition: The precise operation counted by a limit: generation, primitive action, token, cost or elapsed time.
notes: Definition imported from stable runtime evidence bundle; source-derived working definition, not an exhaustive taxonomy.

name: Remote exec semantics
definition: Process, output, timeout, cancellation and cleanup contract behind an execution interface.
notes: Definition imported from stable runtime evidence bundle; source-derived working definition, not an exhaustive taxonomy.

name: Checkpoint scope
definition: The registered state and filesystem subset captured and restored, excluding untracked external side effects.
notes: Definition imported from stable runtime evidence bundle; source-derived working definition, not an exhaustive taxonomy.

name: Evaluation cache identity
definition: Fields used to identify a reusable prediction or report; omitted content changes require invalidation.
notes: Definition imported from stable runtime evidence bundle; source-derived working definition, not an exhaustive taxonomy.

name: Computer action transport
definition: Converts agent actions into remote input/program execution and feedback, with endpoint-specific failure semantics.
notes: Definition imported from stable runtime evidence bundle; source-derived working definition, not an exhaustive taxonomy.

name: Original runtime mechanism lab
definition: Self-written counterexample experiments, distinct from reproducing an upstream benchmark.
notes: Definition imported from stable runtime evidence bundle; source-derived working definition, not an exhaustive taxonomy.

name: Black-box agent protocol
definition: A high-level session/prompt interface to an external agent that manages its own model, tools and execution.
notes: Definition imported from stable runtime evidence bundle; source-derived working definition, not an exhaustive taxonomy.

name: Simulated-user evaluation
definition: Evaluation in which a separate user model reveals requirements and responds to the target agent, making user policy, information partition and role accounting part of the measured system.
notes: Definition imported from stable runtime evidence bundle; source-derived working definition, not an exhaustive taxonomy.
